"""Observe unchanged owners on saved raw detections; never read video/pixels."""
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict, fields
from enum import Enum
from copy import deepcopy
from unittest.mock import patch
import hashlib, json, math, subprocess, sys

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
prior = root / 'sample/output/s11-d2-recipe-artifact-20261008-001'
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'src'))
from oil_tracker.domain.detection import PhaseDetection, BoundaryCandidate
from oil_tracker.domain.enums import BoundaryKind, FillState
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import InspectionRecipe
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.observation_sequence_resolver import ObservationSequenceResolver
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_interface_selector import BoundedOilInterfaceSelector, oil_candidate_emission, oil_candidate_confidence
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_phase_lifecycle import OilMaterialPhaseLifecycleOwner

def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def norm(v):
    if isinstance(v, Enum): return v.value
    if isinstance(v, float) and not math.isfinite(v): return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, dict): return {k: norm(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v, (set, frozenset)): return sorted(norm(x) for x in v)
    if isinstance(v, (tuple, list)): return [norm(x) for x in v]
    return v
def save(name, v):
    p=out/name
    assert not p.exists(), name
    p.write_text(json.dumps(norm(v), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)+'\n')
def ref(r):
    d={f.name:getattr(r,f.name) for f in fields(r) if f.name not in ('candidate','evidence')}
    return dict(d, source=r.candidate.source, kind=r.candidate.kind, y=r.candidate.y,
                emission=oil_candidate_emission(r), confidence=oil_candidate_confidence(r))
def refs(rs): return [[ref(r) for r in group] for group in rs]
def node(n): return {'kind':n.kind,'emission':n.emission,'identity':n.identity,'ref':ref(n.candidate_ref) if n.candidate_ref else None}
def decode(d):
    d=deepcopy(d);d['fill_state']=FillState(d['fill_state'])
    d['candidates']=[BoundaryCandidate(**dict(c,kind=BoundaryKind(c['kind']))) for c in d['candidates']]
    return PhaseDetection(**d)

prior_receipt=json.loads((prior/'pipeline-receipt.json').read_text())
for name,h in prior_receipt['outputs'].items(): assert sha(prior/name)==h,name
previous_pins=json.loads((prior/'replay-preflight.json').read_text())['inputs']
# Byte identity of current implementation to the previous full-pipeline pair.
source_pins={n:h for n,h in previous_pins.items() if n.startswith('src/')}
for n,h in source_pins.items(): assert sha(root/n)==h,n
pins={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),prior/'pipeline-receipt.json',prior/'replay-preflight.json']}
for variant,recipe_name in [('unregistered','baseline.oilrecipe'),('registered_pink822','registered-pink822.oilrecipe')]:
    for p in [prior/f'{variant}-raw.json',prior/f'{variant}-completed.json',prior/recipe_name]: pins[str(p.relative_to(root))]=sha(p)
save('preflight.json',{'source_head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
                      'input_pins':pins,'source_pins':source_pins,'video_read':False,'detector_rerun':False,
                      'rule':'Observe existing owners. Require complete output equality before causal interpretation.'})
outputs={};checks={}
for variant,recipe_name in [('unregistered','baseline.oilrecipe'),('registered_pink822','registered-pink822.oilrecipe')]:
    raw=json.loads((prior/f'{variant}-raw.json').read_text())
    glass=InspectionRecipe.from_dict(json.loads((prior/recipe_name).read_text())).glasses[0]
    resolver=ObservationSequenceResolver();captured={'selector':[]}
    owner=resolver._oil
    prepare=owner.admission_evidence.prepare
    def observe_prepare(*a,**kw):
        r=prepare(*a,**kw);captured['admission']=refs(r[0]);return r
    owner.admission_evidence.prepare=observe_prepare
    oppose=owner.tracklet_opposition._apply_track_opposition
    def observe_oppose(*a,**kw):
        r=oppose(*a,**kw);captured['opposition']=refs(r[0]);return r
    owner.tracklet_opposition._apply_track_opposition=observe_oppose
    track=owner.tracklet_opposition.resolve
    def observe_track(*a,**kw):
        r=track(*a,**kw);captured['tracklets']=refs(r[0].refs_by_frame);captured['summaries']=[asdict(s) for s in r[0].summaries];return r
    owner.tracklet_opposition.resolve=observe_track
    lifecycle=owner.path_lifecycle.resolve
    def observe_lifecycle(*a,**kw):
        r=lifecycle(*a,**kw)
        captured['layers']=[[node(n) for n in l] for l in r.layers]
        captured['paths']={k:[node(n) for n in getattr(r,k)] for k in ('best_path','bounded_path','spike_suppressed_path','path')}
        return r
    owner.path_lifecycle.resolve=observe_lifecycle
    censor=BoundedOilInterfaceSelector._censor_competing_tracklets
    def observe_censor(self, selected, layer, scores):
        result=censor(self,selected,layer,scores)
        captured['selector'].append({'before':node(selected),'after':node(result),
                                    'nodes':[dict(node(n),bounded_score=s) for n,s in zip(layer,scores,strict=True)]})
        captured['selector_policy']=asdict(self.policy)
        return result
    phase=OilMaterialPhaseLifecycleOwner.resolve
    def observe_phase(self,*a,**kw):
        r=phase(self,*a,**kw);captured['phase']=asdict(r);captured['phase_policy']=asdict(self.policy);return r
    with patch.object(BoundedOilInterfaceSelector,'_censor_competing_tracklets',observe_censor),patch.object(OilMaterialPhaseLifecycleOwner,'resolve',observe_phase):
        result=resolver.resolve([decode(d) for d in raw],glass,glass.initial_state)
    actual=norm([asdict(d) for d in result.detections]);expected=json.loads((prior/f'{variant}-completed.json').read_text())
    equal=actual==expected
    if not equal:
        changes=[{'frame':a['frame_index'],'keys':[k for k in a if a[k]!=b[k]]} for a,b in zip(actual,expected,strict=True) if a!=b]
        save(f'{variant}-mismatch.json',changes)
    assert equal, variant
    assert len(captured['selector'])==113
    save(f'{variant}-stages.json',captured)
    outputs[f'{variant}-stages.json']=sha(out/f'{variant}-stages.json');checks[variant]={'frames':113,'complete_output_equal':True}
    print(variant,checks[variant],flush=True)
for n,h in pins.items(): assert sha(root/n)==h,n
for n,h in source_pins.items(): assert sha(root/n)==h,n
save('receipt.json',{'status':'COMPLETE','preflight_sha256':sha(out/'preflight.json'),'input_preserved':True,
                    'checks':checks,'source_files_identical_to_prior_run':len(source_pins),
                    'video_read':False,'detector_rerun':False,'completed_resolver_rerun':True,
                    'labels_changed':False,'auto_acceptance':False,'outputs':outputs})

"""Observe assignment edges in the same saved-input replay, without intervention."""
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
from enum import Enum
from copy import deepcopy
from unittest.mock import patch
import hashlib,json,sys
root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;prior=root/'sample/output/s11-d2-recipe-artifact-20261008-001'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'src'))
from oil_tracker.domain.detection import PhaseDetection,BoundaryCandidate
from oil_tracker.domain.enums import BoundaryKind,FillState
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import InspectionRecipe
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.observation_sequence_resolver import ObservationSequenceResolver
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_interface_tracklets import DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder,_track_velocity
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre=json.loads((out/'preflight.json').read_text())
for n,h in (pre['input_pins']|pre['source_pins']).items():assert sha(root/n)==h,n
def encode(v):
 if isinstance(v,Enum):return v.value
 if isinstance(v,(set,frozenset)):return sorted(v)
 raise TypeError(type(v))
def clean(v):return json.loads(json.dumps(v,default=encode))
def decode(d):
 d=deepcopy(d);d['fill_state']=FillState(d['fill_state']);d['candidates']=[BoundaryCandidate(**dict(c,kind=BoundaryKind(c['kind']))) for c in d['candidates']];return PhaseDetection(**d)
def hypothesis(h):return {'id':h.identity,'frame_offset':h.frame_offset,'y':h.y,'members':[[r.candidate_offset,r.candidate.y] for r in h.members]}
outputs={}
for v,recipe in [('unregistered','baseline.oilrecipe'),('registered_pink822','registered-pink822.oilrecipe')]:
 captured=[];current=[]
 orig=DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder._ambiguities
 def observe(self,pairs):
  frame=pairs[0][4].frame_offset if pairs else None
  snap={'frame':frame,'pairs':[{'cost':cost,'track':tid,'confirmed':tr.confirmed,'last':hypothesis(tr.last.hypothesis),
                               'velocity':_track_velocity(tr),'row':hypothesis(h)} for cost,tid,hid,tr,h in pairs]}
  result=orig(self,pairs);snap['conflict_tracks']=sorted(t.identity for t in result[0]);snap['conflict_rows']=sorted(result[1])
  captured.append(snap);current[:]=[snap];return result
 order=DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder._ordered_assignment_pairs
 def observe_order(self,pairs,conflicts):
  result=order(self,pairs,conflicts)
  current[0]['actual_assignments']=[{'cost':c,'track':tid,'row':hid} for c,tid,hid,tr,h in self._greedy_assignments(result,conflicts)]
  current[0]['policy']=asdict(self.policy);return result
 raw=json.loads((prior/f'{v}-raw.json').read_text());glass=InspectionRecipe.from_dict(json.loads((prior/recipe).read_text())).glasses[0]
 with patch.object(DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder,'_ambiguities',observe),patch.object(DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder,'_ordered_assignment_pairs',observe_order):
  r=ObservationSequenceResolver().resolve([decode(d) for d in raw],glass,glass.initial_state)
 assert clean([asdict(d) for d in r.detections])==json.loads((prior/f'{v}-completed.json').read_text())
 p=out/f'{v}-assignments.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(clean(captured),indent=2)+'\n');outputs[p.name]=sha(p)
for n,h in (pre['input_pins']|pre['source_pins']).items():assert sha(root/n)==h,n
p=out/'assignment-receipt.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'COMPLETE','preflight_sha256':sha(out/'preflight.json'),
 'runner_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'full_output_equal_each_variant':113,'inputs_preserved':True,'outputs':outputs,
 'video_read':False,'detector_rerun':False,'new_human_review':False},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Full output equality: 113 + 113; assignment edges captured')

"""Compare fixed reciprocal-attribution probe using the saved 2 x 113 inputs."""
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
from enum import Enum
from copy import deepcopy
from unittest.mock import patch
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;prior=root/'sample/output/s11-d2-recipe-artifact-20261008-001'
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/'src'),str(out)]
from reciprocal_probe import install
from oil_tracker.domain.detection import PhaseDetection,BoundaryCandidate
from oil_tracker.domain.enums import BoundaryKind,FillState
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import InspectionRecipe
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.observation_sequence_resolver import ObservationSequenceResolver
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_interface_tracklets import DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre=json.loads((out/'preflight.json').read_text());pins=pre['input_pins']|pre['source_pins']
for n,h in pins.items():assert sha(root/n)==h,n
def save(n,v):
 p=out/n;assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,default=lambda x:x.value if isinstance(x,Enum) else sorted(x))+'\n')
save('probe-preflight.json',{'source_head':pre['source_head'],'prior_preflight_sha256':sha(out/'preflight.json'),
 'implementation_sha256':sha(out/'reciprocal_probe.py'),'runner_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),
 'hypothesis':'Nonpreferred merge edges must not terminate two mutually clear physically-proposed continuations.',
 'scope':'Attribution of ambiguity only; no new identity evidence or efficacy acceptance.',
 'falsification':'Any protected target loss, return of registered false target, unsafe real merge/split inheritance or new known wrong output rejects adoption.',
 'evaluation':'Both unregistered and registered saved sequences; all seven target and three negative anchors. No threshold adjustment.',
 'unknown':'Unreviewed rows and Windows efficacy stay unknown.'})
def decode(d):
 d=deepcopy(d);d['fill_state']=FillState(d['fill_state']);d['candidates']=[BoundaryCandidate(**dict(c,kind=BoundaryKind(c['kind']))) for c in d['candidates']];return PhaseDetection(**d)
targets={1140:9,1200:4,1260:4,1275:12,1320:9,1485:19,1560:20};negatives={1200:10,1260:15,1320:21}
summary={}
for v,recipe in [('unregistered','baseline.oilrecipe'),('registered_pink822','registered-pink822.oilrecipe')]:
 raw=json.loads((prior/f'{v}-raw.json').read_text());glass=InspectionRecipe.from_dict(json.loads((prior/recipe).read_text())).glasses[0]
 before=json.loads((prior/f'{v}-completed.json').read_text())
 with patch.object(DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder,'_ambiguities',install(DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder._ambiguities)):
  result=ObservationSequenceResolver().resolve([decode(d) for d in raw],glass,glass.initial_state)
 after=json.loads(json.dumps([asdict(d) for d in result.detections],default=lambda x:x.value))
 save(f'{v}-probe-completed.json',after)
 changes=[];controls=[]
 for a,b in zip(before,after,strict=True):
  f=a['frame_index'];sa=a['debug_metrics']['sequence_decision_witness']['selection'];sb=b['debug_metrics']['sequence_decision_witness']['selection']
  if a['raw_oil_air_level_y']!=b['raw_oil_air_level_y']:changes.append({'frame':f,'time':a['time_sec'],'before':a['raw_oil_air_level_y'],'after':b['raw_oil_air_level_y']})
  if f in targets:controls.append({'frame':f,'target_idx':targets[f],'negative_idx':negatives.get(f),'before':sa,'after':sb})
  chosen=b['debug_metrics']['sequence_decision_witness']['selection'].get('selected_candidate')
  if chosen:
   # Existing exact source/offset/Y witness is the publication authority.
   assert b['raw_oil_air_level_y']==chosen['y']
 summary[v]={'changes':changes,'controls':controls,'numeric_before':sum(d['raw_oil_air_level_y'] is not None for d in before),'numeric_after':sum(d['raw_oil_air_level_y'] is not None for d in after)}
for n,h in pins.items():assert sha(root/n)==h,n
save('probe-result.json',summary)
save('probe-receipt.json',{'status':'COMPLETE','preflight_sha256':sha(out/'probe-preflight.json'),'inputs_preserved':True,
 'video_read':False,'detector_rerun':False,'completed_resolver_rerun':True,'production_changed':False,'labels_changed':False,'auto_acceptance':False,
 'outputs':{n:sha(out/n) for n in ['probe-result.json','unregistered-probe-completed.json','registered_pink822-probe-completed.json']}})
for v,s in summary.items():
 print(v,'numeric',s['numeric_before'],s['numeric_after'],'changed',len(s['changes']))
 print(s['changes'])
 print([(c['frame'],c['target_idx'],c['after']['selected_candidate']) for c in s['controls']])

"""Control guard behavior and run existing tracklet contracts with the probe."""
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import hashlib,json,sys
root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path[:0]=[str(root),str(root/'src'),str(out)]
from reciprocal_probe import install
from tests.unit.test_oil_interface_tracklets import _policy,_ref
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_candidate_authority import OilCandidateAuthority as A
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_interface_tracklets import DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder as Builder
import pytest

original=Builder._ambiguities;probe=install(original)
def scene(calibrated):
 rows=tuple(tuple(_ref(f,j,y+(5 if j==0 else -5)*f,authority=A.ANCHOR_ELIGIBLE,source=f'owner-{j}') for j,y in enumerate((80.,140.))) for f in range(3))
 children=tuple(_ref(3,j,y,authority=A.CONTINUATION_ELIGIBLE,source=f'child-{j}',calibrated_high_recall=calibrated and j!=1) for j,y in enumerate((95.,110.,125.)))
 return rows+(children,)
checks={}
for calibrated in (False,True):
 rows=scene(calibrated);baseline=Builder(_policy()).resolve(rows)
 with patch.object(Builder,'_ambiguities',probe):result=Builder(_policy()).resolve(rows)
 old={r.tracklet_id for r in result.refs_by_frame[2]}
 new={result.refs_by_frame[3][j].tracklet_id for j in (0,2)}
 assert 3 in baseline.incompatible_frames
 if calibrated:
  assert 3 in result.incompatible_frames and old.isdisjoint(new)
 else:
  assert 3 not in result.incompatible_frames and old==new
  assert result.refs_by_frame[3][1].tracklet_id not in old
 checks['calibrated_only_children' if calibrated else 'physical_children']={'pass':True,'baseline_conflict':True,'probe_conflict':3 in result.incompatible_frames,'old_owner_ids_preserved':old==new}
with patch.object(Builder,'_ambiguities',probe):
 status=pytest.main(['-q','tests/unit/test_oil_interface_tracklets.py'])
p=out/'probe-contracts.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps({'runner_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'checks':checks,'existing_tracklet_suite_exit_code':int(status),'production_changed':False},indent=2)+'\n')
assert status==0

interpretation_limits: Exact output equality validates observation, not physical efficacy.
Track IDs from different variants are not cross-run identities.
No production repair: physical-proposal-preserving reciprocal probe has zero effect on all 226 detections.
F1485 target is publishable but scores -infinity after an incompatible committed owner; f1560 target is no longer admitted.
Greedy row grouping, established-first assignment and nonpreferred merge ambiguity interact; no unique earliest physical cause is certified.
Seven reviewed targets are regression identities, not scalar/path truth. Unreviewed observations remain unknown.
